content.title: About
content.content: Taquito is a ready‑to‑eat product consisting of a boiled chicken egg packaged in a convenient single‑serving pouch. The egg retains its natural flavor and nutritional properties, while the packaging provides a long shelf life without refrigeration.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Taquito is made from free‑range eggs, which enhances their nutritional value.
Each pouch contains exactly one medium egg weighing about 50 g.
The product undergoes thermal treatment at 75 °C for 5 minutes, ensuring safety.
Taquito is handy for hiking, work, or school lunches.
The packaging is fully recyclable and meets environmental standards.

items.title: Rich in protein
items.content: An egg provides about 6 g of high‑quality protein essential for tissue growth and repair.

items.title: Source of vitamin D
items.content: Vitamin D in the yolk supports calcium absorption and bone health.

items.title: Contains vitamin B12
items.content: Vitamin B12 is important for nervous system function and red blood cell formation.

items.title: Contains lecithin
items.content: Lecithin aids brain function and fat metabolism.

items.title: Low in carbohydrates
items.content: Taquito contains virtually no carbs, making it suitable for low‑carb diets.

items.title: Egg allergy
items.content: People allergic to eggs may experience reactions ranging from mild to severe.

items.title: Cholesterol content
items.content: The yolk contains cholesterol; individuals with high cholesterol should consume in moderation.

items.title: Shelf life after opening
items.content: Once opened, the product should be eaten within 24 hours and kept refrigerated.

items.title: Thermal processing
items.content: Despite heat treatment, a damaged package could allow bacterial contamination.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Taquito can be eaten straight from the pouch, added to salads, sandwiches, or used as a protein boost in smoothies. If desired, gently warm the egg in a microwave for 10–15 seconds.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the unopened pouch in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep it refrigerated and consume within a day. Discard any product with a compromised package.
